All three read as stylized animated feature sets: chunky rounded chair and cabinet with broad bevels, curtains sculpted in a few generous folds, smooth matte upholstery, broad designed wood-grain curves, soft warm animation light and readable depth with minimal focus falloff. Options differ in chair back, cabinet shelf treatment and window mullions but share the same stylized treatment.
